items.stem: Briefly explain why the derivative of a product is not the product of the derivatives.
items.answer: When both factors change, the change in uv comes from u changing while v is fixed and v changing while u is fixed; this gives u′v + uv′, e.g. (x · x)′ = 2x, not 1 × 1 = 1.

(b) Use technology to sketch N and N′, and state the limiting value of N. (c) Given that N″(t) = 0 when 1 = 54e^(−0.86t), find the time of the point of inflection. items.stem: Explain how the second derivative can be used to classify a stationary point.
items.answer: If f′(a) = 0 and f″(a) > 0 the gradient is increasing through zero, so the point is a minimum; if f″(a) < 0 it is a maximum; if f″(a) = 0 the test is inconclusive.
